statement: The reader's warrant verifier MUST run at settlement grade with the required-binding option, so that a record whose own actor has no signature by a key the reader's trust config binds is an error; any `ERR`, and a verifier that produces no report, MUST refuse, while warnings are shown to the reader and do not refuse.

decisions.because: The rule was strict from the first draft as a fail-closed default. The mutant 'tolerate-all-warnings' showed it is load-bearing, and why: an accept for bob@demo.test signed with Mallory's key verifies ok:true, errors:0 under warrant 0.10.0 settlement grade with Bob's key in the reader's trust config; the only signal is the WARN 'signature unbound: key 415960d5a615 claims actor bob@demo.test' (warrant SPEC §5.1 makes bound/unbound a report). Without this rule the profile would accept Mallory's signature as Bob's.

counterexample.observed: VERIFIED: propose by alice@demo.test, accept by bob@demo.test

decisions.because: A verifier that cannot run (wrong --warrant path) or prints no report raised an uncaught exception: no verdict, a traceback. The statement now names that case; it refuses as WARRANT.

counterexample.observed: FileNotFoundError: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: '/nonexistent/warrant'

decisions.because: Mutant 'base-grade' went OFF_TARGET once a missing report became a WARRANT refusal: every valid contract then refused, but no witness of this statement failed for the reason the statement names. Added a positive witness that the reader's warrant reported settlement grade.

counterexample.observed: OFF_TARGET (17 tests of other statements failed, none of WPDF-T2)

decisions.because: Measured: an appended co-signature, valid or not, claiming an unrelated actor makes the contract refuse, because warrant reports it as a WARN. warrant's envelope rule says such a signature is reported and excluded, never fatal; this statement is broader than that. Kept as fail-closed and pinned as a known limitation; the narrower rule needs a verifier option (proposed to warrant as WRT-018) or message parsing.

counterexample.observed: REFUSED WARRANT (WARN … signature does not verify (excluded): actor carol@demo.test)
counterexample.expected (ideal): VERIFIED: the junk co-signature is excluded

decisions.because: warrant 0.11.0 shipped --require-bound (WRT-018, proposed from this repository after the measurements in this history). The statement moves from 'refuse every warning but unadopted root' to 'require the actor's binding; refuse on ERR; show warnings'. The pinned limitation (8b21a6e) is resolved: a junk or unbound co-signature is excluded and shown.

counterexample.observed (0.10.0, previous statement): REFUSED WARRANT over an invalid co-signature claiming carol@demo.test
counterexample.expected: VERIFIED, the co-signature shown as a warning
